text:
Done — I refreshed the UI and split the frontend code into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What changed:
- Gave the app a more modern visual style:
  - softer gradients and glassy header
  - cleaner cards, buttons, badges, and modal styling
  - improved spacing, shadows, and responsive behavior
- Split frontend logic into smaller files:
  - `public/js/ui.js` for shared UI helpers
  - `public/js/tasks.js` for dashboard/task behavior
  - `public/js/auth.js` kept for auth behavior, but cleaned up to use shared helpers
- Updated the HTML pages to load the new JS structure and use the refreshed styling
- Tidied `src/routes/tasks.js` a bit while keeping the same functionality
- Verified everything still works by running the test suite successfully

Files added/updated:
- `public/css/style.css`
- `public/js/ui.js`
- `public/js/tasks.js`
- `public/js/auth.js`
- `public/index.html`
- `public/login.html`
- `public/signup.html`
- `src/routes/tasks.js`

If you want, I can also do a second pass to split the CSS into smaller files next.
